title: The Home page, next version — round 1: folding rooms, favourites, Edit

steps.headline: A room's lights are one card that folds; the arrow opens it to show each light, and the page remembers which you left open.
steps.changed: Lights used to be a long list of tiles. Now each room shows one Lights card; the round arrow on its right shows or hides every light underneath. Destin's Room is open here, Living Room and Kitchen are folded.
steps.notice: TVs, speakers, the thermostat and cameras stay outside the card, always in view. A room with only one light shows that light's tile, no card.
steps.risk: Folds are remembered on this computer only; the phone (later) starts folded.

steps.path: Pages → Home, the top of a lights card
steps.headline: The card's top tile is a bulb with "All" under it: press it to switch the whole room's lights; it says how many are on.
steps.changed: It replaces the All on / All off text button. It glows in the colour of a light that is on, reads "3 of 3 on" or "All off", and flips: any light on turns them all off; none on turns them all on.
steps.notice: It never touches the TV or speaker. Lights that are not responding, or that you hid, are left alone.
steps.risk: Pressing the tile switches lights; only the round arrow folds the card. Both live on the same row.

steps.path: Pages → Home, the top of the page
steps.headline: Things you star appear in a Favourites row at the top, side by side, and work exactly like they do in their room.
steps.changed: New. Here the floor lamp and the thermostat are starred. Starring is done in Edit mode.
steps.notice: A starred thing still appears in its own room too, so it shows twice. With nothing starred, the row is not there.
steps.risk: Favourites are this page's own: Home Assistant's app does not see them.

steps.headline: Everything off asks first, "Turn off 5 lights?" with Turn off and Cancel in its place, then switches off every light in the house.
steps.changed: New, beside Edit. The question replaces the button on the same line rather than opening a window. It is greyed when no light is on.
steps.notice: Only lights: TVs, speakers and the thermostat keep running.
steps.risk: The question is not in this picture; press Everything off in the test app to see it.

steps.headline: Edit puts a row of small controls under everything: star, move up or down, rename, change room, hide, and open in Home Assistant.
steps.changed: "Hide things" became Edit. Each room's name also gets up/down arrows and an Open in Home Assistant button. Every lights card opens while editing so each light can be reached. Choosing "New room…" in the room list asks for a name and moves it there.
steps.notice: Order, stars and hiding are saved by this page. Names and rooms change in Home Assistant itself, so they show everywhere.
steps.risk: Rename and change room are not connected to Home Assistant yet (that part is being built alongside): today they change the page only, and the next check puts the old name back.
